Does your system support hot-plug FAN board? It is weird.
I am not sure, but it seems that dbus-sensor can not read Fanboard's sensors, Is it ok?
How about FAN control/Fan sensors services? Should you stop them before?

The YV4 has two 48V HSCs. The objective of this service is to power off one unit while maintaining operation of the other, followed by the replacement of the fan board.

We also have other services to ensure that after power off one half of the power supply, the fan on the remaining side can ramp its PWM up to 100%.

Why do you exit 2 instead 1?
I want to use different exit numbers to distinguish error types: exit 1 for runtime errors and exit 2 for parameter errors.

Alright, I have added comments in the new code.
I think you use `get-property` to get the type property

Because on the YV4, the Medusa board's 48V HSC has two different sources, I think it would be easier to directly check the value of the 'Type' property rather than judging based on the results returned by the two interfaces.
https://github.com/openbmc/entity-manager/tree/f7252577794639be8f22da52ec09c621de44dcda/configurations/meta

The issue is that entity-manager's interfaces are not well-defined in a way to know exactly which interface to get the property from.  You have a essentially `Configure.TYPE` interface defined, which if you're trying to determine the type, you can't guess at.

Introspection is currently the only way.
